claims: The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion officially releases on May 22, 2026.
Preorders for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion are now available on the Pokémon Center.
Prerelease events for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion will take place between May 9th and May 17th, 2026.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion features new Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, including Mega Greninja ex, Mega Pyroar ex, Mega Floette ex, and Mega Dragalge ex.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion has over 120 cards.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion includes over 20 Trainer cards.
Prerelease promos for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion include Delphox, Ampharos, Crobat, and Goodra.
Products for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion include Elite Trainer Boxes (ETBs) and Booster Bundles.
